force_endpoints: dR/dq versus materialized direct coefficient source using identical live q
Every existing R/S derivative of R versus materialized direct coefficient and independent live full-X references
Every existing R/S derivative of sum-member mean CE+R versus both references
endpoint.criteria: Identical Q01 float32 elementwise abs(a-b)/(atol+rtol*abs(reference))<=1 for all elements; values3e-6/3e-4, derivatives1e-4/3e-3; prospective application to these B2 real-graph and CE+R endpoints; no post-outcome widening
endpoint.admission_limit: A successful run admits only these fixed full-graph B2 CPU-cache/CUDA endpoints under these thresholds. It does not admit B128 GPU numerical equivalence, CUDA sparse recurrences, trained donors, competence or scientific performance.
